Each entry records the owner's decision (2026-11-19: all entries approved) (ADR-050: 'similar permissive licences approved by a human'; unknown licences only with human approval). The owner records a decision by setting status to approved or rejected in a pull request. DeployToolRules fails when a locked package has a licence that is neither on the list nor recorded here with the same licence. These tools run in CI only and are not distributed with the app.
